Bendigeidfran son of Llŷr, crowned king of the Island of the Mighty, is sitting on the rock of Harlech with his brother Manawydan and his half-brothers Nisien, the peacemaker, and Efnysien, the maker of quarrels, when thirteen ships come from Ireland under a shield of peace. They bring Matholwch, king of Ireland, who asks for Branwen daughter of Llŷr so that Ireland and the Island of the Mighty may be bound together; the council grants her, and the marriage is made at Aberffraw in pavilions, for no house has ever held Bendigeidfran. Efnysien, angered that his sister was given away without his leave, maims Matholwch's horses, and Matholwch, taking it for a deliberate insult, makes for his ships.
